resources.string_add: Section navigation in the apps on phones and tablets

When this menu is a section's menu, how the apps show it on phones and tablets: Tabs above the content, or List, where the section opens on a list of its pages and each page opens from it with Back (the account's Settings). List needs the section's own page, which the menu names in its App config (hub); a menu without one keeps tabs.
resources.string_upd: When this menu is a section's menu (the tabs of its pages), how the apps show it on large screens: Tabs above the content, as the site shows them, or Sidebar, a column beside the content, for a section with many pages. Phones and tablets have their own setting, below.
